exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-179 requires validation occurring before canonicalization/modification that creates dangerous inputs. The demonstrated code performs URL parsing (canonicalization) before comparison (validation), which is the correct order for this security check.

connection.evidence: User-controlled URL parameter flows through urllib_parse.urlparse to extract netloc, then compared against the current host parameter from request.get_host() to determine redirect safety.

diff_causality.evidence: This line implements the core security logic for open redirect prevention. Reverting would remove the netloc comparison check entirely.
